label: Other business
recognise: Any business that fits none of the other site types.
research: What websites of similar businesses usually show, and what their customers look for before they get in touch.

pages.title: Home
pages.purpose: What the business does, why to choose it and what to do next.

pages.title: About us
pages.purpose: The business's story and the people behind it.

pages.title: Services
pages.purpose: What the business offers, in plain words.

pages.title: Contact
pages.purpose: How to get in touch and where to find the business.

pages.title: Privacy policy
pages.purpose: How information sent through the site is used.

sections.header: The business's name or logo, the main pages and one clear call to action.
sections.footer: Contact details, quick links, social links and the privacy policy.
sections.homepage: A clear hero saying what the business does with one call to action; the main offerings; why choose it; a final call to action.

rules: Never invent facts, prices, reviews or awards.

demo.note: Where the owner gave no details, write sample offerings for them to replace. Samples are only ever offerings like these: never sample people, staff photos, opening hours, prices, addresses or phone numbers.

questions.title: What do you offer?
questions.lead: Your main products or services, most important first.
questions.why: The homepage and Services page lead with them.

questions.title: How can customers reach you?
questions.lead: These go in your site details, the footer and the Contact page.
questions.why: Only you know your contact details.

questions.title: What should it look and feel like?
questions.lead: The feel sets the colours; your logo and photos make it yours.
questions.why: Your logo and photos make the site yours.

questions.title: Your story and where else to find you
questions.lead: Real words from you make the About page.
questions.why: Real words for the About page.
